cards.title: Build a reusable EmptyState.svelte component with props

mkdir -p src/lib/components
touch src/lib/components/EmptyState.svelte

cards.title: Map card type scale in Tailwind v3 config
cards.when: Use this when a Tailwind v3 project needs a named card font size with its line height and weight in tailwind.config.js.
cards.cmds:
npm ls tailwindcss
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/index.css -o ./dist/out.css
grep -A3 '\.text-card-title' dist/out.css
npx playwright test tests/card-typography.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify card skeleton clears within 400ms
cards.when: Use when a card shows a skeleton placeholder while its data loads and you must prove the real content replaces it in time.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright install chromium
npx playwright test tests/card-loading.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Audit loading card contrast and reduced motion
cards.when: Use when a loading card's skeleton shimmer and status text must meet WCAG contrast and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
cards.cmds:
grep -n prefers-reduced-motion styles/card.css
grep -n animation styles/card.css
